sourceTitle: Three Sailor Boys; or, Adrift in the Pacific
description: "Three Sailor Boys; or, Adrift in the Pacific" by Verney Lovett Cameron is a novel written in the early 20th century. The story follows three boys, Sam Hawse, Tom Arbor, and Bill Seaman, who escape harsh conditions in a workhouse to pursue their dreams of life at sea.
